situation: An elderly clockmaker in his workshop finishes the final gear assembly of a grand twelve-dial astronomical clock showing the complete cycle of the seasons.
subject: the twelve months of the year represented on twelve small painted dials
brief: An old man in a dusty workshop stands before a towering wooden astronomical clock whose face features a circle of twelve distinct painted dials, each showing a different seasonal transition from winter snow to summer harvest. His calloused hand gently touches the brass marker pointing to the twelfth and final segment of the painted ring. The warm afternoon light slants across the wood grain, illuminating the full circular cycle laid out in front of him.
